claim.text: A fixed partition of the SAME original positive integer thin trace Gram into consecutive 2- or 5-row blocks might provide a uniform, source-preserving improvement over the existing analytic Hadamard upper. Pentagon coherence is an audit target, not an assumed bound gain.
claim.scope: Prospective bounded pilot and, only if activated, a universally quantified theorem on admissible D >= 322^4; all prior scalar/geometry/prime runs are preexisting evidence, not outcomes of this preregistration.
assumptions: Exact original ellipsePairs D (thinRadius D), integerRectangularTraceGram Q D S R S
ordinary Z jets with W fixed and weights (2,2D)
R=floor(D/4), S=floor(R/25), original class-one number-field hypotheses
G_D positive definite (must be established, never assumed for new Q)
row ordering and block partitions frozen before outcome observation
forbidden_promotions: No field-bound reduction from a toy 2x2 determinant
No identification of five blocks with the categorical pentagon
No changing observation sets, weights, determinant, auxiliary primes or binary exponent
No inference of uniform gain from Hadamard-Fischer nonnegativity
No claim of external independent verification from model-authored CI

specification.intended_object: Original positive integer trace Gram G_D, with rowwise H_row=sum log G_ii and fixed consecutive block upper H_block=sum_B log det G_BB, both on G_D itself.
invariants: integer Gram source and positive determinant unchanged
Hadamard-Fischer direction logdet G <= H_block <= H_row
block sizes 1,2,5 fixed; canonical row order and deterministic control permutation
source odd-prime/binary lower and field equivalence unaffected
known_answer_cases: positive diagonal synthetic matrix yields exactly zero block advantage
positive definite 2x2 [[2,1],[1,2]] gives strict finite advantage, independently calculable
original small historical source-Gram fixtures only after exact D,R,S,Q frozen

implementation.environment: Prospective Lean project at main after PR #123; no new block solver or pentagon proof has been executed
implementation.live_entrypoint: Not activated: present source upper ThinUpper323/UpperScalars323; optional future pilot independently frozen
implementation.representation: Exact source integer Gram; real log of positive principal minor determinants; no replacement mesh

metric.name: typed effect tuple (I_pi(D), wall-time, peak-memory, integer-bit-length, source-fidelity)
metric.units: primary I=(H_row-H_block)/(R^2 S) dimensionless; costs seconds, bytes and bits
equivalence_attacks: simultaneous row/column permutation with blocks reindexed consistently
singleton partition exactly equals rowwise sum
positive diagonal G has zero improvement
certified determinant preserved by integral unimodular changes only; arbitrary basis changes not assumed integral

black_box: independently evaluate exact 2x2 minor and full det on a frozen tiny source Gram; audit sign/direction
structural: trace source G_D, row indices, Q_D, derivative type and weights; ensure padded ellipse enters count only
property_based: on random symmetric positive definite small integer matrices verify H_block<=H_row and det G<=product block det
metamorphic: permutation equivariance with consistent block relabeling
fuzzing: degenerate and nearly singular SPD small fixtures with checked positivity and no log of nonpositive minors
historical: repeat previously integrated 323 thin-Gram source and PR #123 negative controls without changing their definitions

matched_baselines: same original analytic rowwise upper from ThinUpper323
fixed 2-row and 5-row consecutive blocks in canonical order
deterministically permuted input with consistently transformed partition
negative_controls: diagonal SPD matrix must have I=0
positive 2x2 known answer tests strict gain but is not an asymptotic source proof
arbitrary mesh/padded Gram swap is rejected before interpreting results
controls.compute_parity: same exact Gram, arithmetic precision, input samples and published wall-clock/peak-memory budget; no hidden oracle compute
controls.parameter_parity: not applicable: no trained model parameters; block sizes and selection fixed before outcomes
controls.sampling_parity: predeclare exact original historical toy inputs before any block results; same inputs for every partition
controls.data_access_parity: all variants read identical canonical Q_D and G_D; no additional number-field metadata

preregistration.prediction: Small correlated positive-definite source-Gram cases may show I>0; a uniform >=1e-4 gain is uncertain and not asserted. Count-only mesh and categorical pentagon are unlikely to affect the current 322 bottleneck.
preregistration.primary_metric: Uniform source-certified I_pi(D)>=1/10000 for all admissible D>=322^4, AND a same-Gram analytic upper at least that much stronger; with resource parity and no changed arithmetic lower.
preregistration.uncertainty_method: exact arithmetic on frozen finite fixtures, then Lean universal proof and standard-axiom audit for promoted claim; finite sample variance reported but never extrapolated to universal D
preregistration.kill_condition: Retire the geometry-performance claim for substituted Gram/Q, tautological I>=0 only, normalized gain that vanishes or fails 1e-4 uniform bound, unjustified correlation floor, or cheaper existing-radius/count estimate with equivalent improvement.
preregistration.stop_condition: Stay protocol-only until 322 source-to-field assembly passes or an identified analytic source obstruction appears; if activated permit one frozen toy pilot and one universal lemma attempt, then stop or explicitly open a new registration.
preregistration.promotion_rule: H to M only for disclosed exact finite experiments with independent oracle; P only for universal source-exact Lean theorem and full-root controls; field theorem requires original field map and independent semantic review, not this manifest.
